title: Japanese Encephalitis Virus Isolation
author: Wenjing Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdaui2ew

steps.title: Inoculate Vero Cells
steps.instruction: Inoculate filtered sterile mosquito grinding solution into 24-well plates containing Vero cells grown to 80% monolayer.

substeps.instruction: Add 70 μl of solution to each well for standard virus isolation.
Add 100 μl to each well if using CSF samples.
Set a 3-well blank control for each plate.

steps.title: Incubate Inoculum
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates at 37℃ for 1 h.

steps.title: Maintain Cell Growth
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of MEM medium containing 2% FBS to each well for maintenance of growth.

substeps.instruction: Observe under a microscope daily for the occurrence of cytopathic effect (CPE).

steps.title: Perform Blind Transmission
steps.instruction: For specimens showing no CPE, perform blind transmission for three generations.
